changes.summary: Verify stock Home before continuing compositor removal
Handle access errors when reading saved TV profiles
Fix experimental Home caller permissions on W21
Recover No-root removal after interrupted installs and omitted packages

acceptance: Project LG OLED55C3RLA / firmware 43.21.71 / webOS SDK 11.2.0: exact macOS ARM64 installer passed Root and No-root setup, Home routing, removal across verified software restart and baseline restoration. Signed Root update and rollback passed with matching versions and profile, physical Home/navigation/emergency controls and audio. Both exact Chinese font faces rendered on C3; Android same-signer upgrade passed in API 35 ARM64. W21 A1/C1 physical acceptance is deferred by the maintainer to device owners. See docs/history/2026-11-14-release-1.20.6-rc-verification.md.
